title: Hand of a woman painting with watercolors
notes: Top-down: a hand rinses a brush in purple water beside a watercolour palette (5.0-5.7 s), lifts it out (5.7-6.6), the camera pans across the paint-splattered wooden table to a sheet of white paper (6.6-9.4) and the hand starts painting over a pencil sketch (9.6-12.2). Literal 'use the colours you like for 10 minutes' on paper. Hands only (slim, a woman's hand), no face. Warm golden daylight, medium brightness (not dark): darken/desaturate a little. No text or logos. One continuous take, 12.3 s (no cut in the pan). No Free clip shows closing a sketchbook (13328/47164/13326 are Restricted, 29983 is part 1); if you prefer pure colour-choosing, in 0.0 gives 5.7 s of palette + dipping.

title: Mixing colors in a paint palette
notes: Close-up of two hands holding a white palette while the brush mixes ultramarine blue with white into a lighter blue: literally 'which colour you enjoyed choosing', and the blues match the swatches in P65/P66/P76. Hands only (a woman's hands, grey nail polish; a few tiny letter tattoos on the fingers, too small to read at normal viewing). Dark apron background, warm, medium-dim. A yellow paint splash on the apron appears at the bottom edge from ~8.5 s (paint, not a logo). From ~11 s the camera pulls back to the torso (face still cropped): stay before 10.5 s. No text or logos. One take, 15.0 s.

title: Amateur band playing rock
notes: Three young men jamming in a small rehearsal room (electric guitar, bass, drums) with a hazy backlight: a band of friends sharing a hobby, 'time with friends is part of the joy'. Faces small and backlit, not the protagonist. Dim, warm/teal, cinematic, usable as is. The letters 'STAY HIGH' taped on an amp at the left edge are readable -> blur_box (the camera drifts slightly; the box covers the amp for the whole take). The bass headstock is seen from the back (no logo); the guitar headstock is too small to read. One take, 11.05 s. Chosen over the pottery-class clips (40011/40015, daylight) because it matches the dim look.

title: Artist Working on a Painting
notes: Back view of a woman (white blouse, hair in a bun) painting a still life at an easel, alone in a warm, dim vintage room with old framed pictures: someone alone with her own work. No face. All centre subtitles, so only the mood matters. FILE IS 1280x720 (mk.py only reaches the 720p asset for this item); fine under the blur. No text or logos. One take, 17.5 s. Same studio shoot as 100483/100467 that group C downloaded (different clip). 9030 and other 'man looking at his canvas' clips are Restricted.

title: Demonstration video of a steaming cup of coffee
notes: A dark ceramic cup of coffee on a saucer (dried orange slices) on a bed of coffee beans, deep red-brown backdrop, soft side light, steam curling up; static camera. Dark, warm, calm 'my evening cup' mood behind the centre subtitles ('what kind of time I like'). No text or logos. One take, 10.4 s. 808 (steaming mug) is taken by group D (st40); the lamp/reading clips 46393/46395 are Restricted. Alt 100252 (pouring tea on a rustic table, already on disk) or 101565 (candle-lit table).

title: Talented drummer playing in a close shot
notes: Side close-up of a drummer's arms and sticks flying over red toms and cymbals against a black background: fast, precise playing that reads instantly as 'very skilled'. No face (only the chin edge at the top-left corner in a few frames). Dark, cinematic, usable as is (cyan/red accents, desaturate a little). No readable logos on the drums or cymbals. One take, 16.1 s. Picked a drummer instead of a guitarist because group D already uses four guitar clips (st35, st37, st38, st42). Alt 50284 = 'Expert guitarist playing the guitar with great skill' (two-hand tapping, dark, Free).

title: Two friends chatting happily
notes: Over-the-shoulder at a cafe table: a woman (afro, mustard turtleneck, beige cardigan) laughs and chats while her red-haired friend (back to camera) hands her a phone; big laugh at 2.5-5 s, then a bright smile while she tells something (6-14 s): 'a face that lights up when talking about next weekend / a small experience that was fun'. Warm, muted, cinematic. Her face is visible (cropped at the eyes for the first ~5 s, then full face); she is one of the people we envied, not the protagonist. The phone screen shows only a dark, blurred photo, no text. One take, 15.0 s. 23381/24367 (group at a dinner table) are Restricted.

title: Modern buildings at dusk
notes: Time-lapse of Shinjuku skyscrapers (the lattice Cocoon Tower) going from late afternoon to night: 7-10 s pale daylight, ~10.6 s pink dusk clouds, ~13 s blue hour, 15-19.9 s night with lit windows and a street lamp: the passing of days, ending on night city lights that lead into P74. Starts fairly BRIGHT (daylight sky) and ends dark. A small Subaru logo sign (blue oval with stars) peeks in at the bottom-right corner -> blur_box (or scale up ~8% to crop it out). One take, 19.9 s; 7.0-19.9 gives 12.9 s at speed 1.0. 30988 (KL day to night) and 27849 are Restricted. Alt 3132 (dusk to night over a town, 10.0 s, needs speed 0.8).

title: Two mountaineers putting away their things during the sunset
notes: Two silhouetted hikers on a rocky hillside pack up their gear against the sunset, then one stands up as if ready to leave: 'putting it away / calling it a day' for quitting or taking a break. Silhouettes only, no faces. Dark, moody, warm sky; usable as is. No text. One take, 10.2 s. 649 (man packing his saxophone, the most literal option) is taken by group D (st32); the instrument-case clips 41709 (group D) and 17546 (Restricted) are not available.

title: Portrait of a man breathing while meditating
notes: Low-angle medium close-up of a young man (long hair tied back, sleeveless top) with eyes closed and one hand on his chest, breathing slowly: listening to his own heart instead of enduring ('내 마음을 무시한 채 버틴다는 뜻이 아니니까요'). Face visible, but all centre subtitles (blurred). Soft neutral daylight, medium brightness: darken. No text. One take, 7.1 s. Alt 4397 (silhouette of a woman with prayer hands at sunrise, already on disk).

title: Man in an office throws a ball of paper into the trash can
notes: SPEED 0.8: the clip is only 6.34 s; 0.5-6.3 s at 0.8 = 7.25 s (need 6.6). Shallow-focus, dim blue-grey office: an out-of-focus man at a desk crumples a sheet of paper and tosses it; focus ends on a mesh waste bin at the bottom of the frame (5.5-6.3 s): 'putting it away too quickly'. Face never in focus. No readable text (the monitor is a blur). NOTE: same set as group D's st33 clip 39846 (bin with paper balls), so it echoes that 'giving up' image; if you'd rather avoid the repeat, alt 100470 (an artist studying her canvas, hesitant; warm, dim, face visible). No Free clip of putting a sketchbook in a drawer exists (13881 and 14693 are Restricted).

title: Watering a flower pot
notes: Low-angle close-up of a potted plant with red flowers backlit by a low sun while a green watering can pours a stream onto it (the stream is visible 0-8 s; the spout comes back into view 24-30 s): giving a small interest water / a chance. Warm golden, strong sun flare at the right: BRIGHT backlight, darken. No text. One take, 30.1 s. 4776 (part 1) avoided; the seedling close-ups (33570, 33422, 46091, 47540) are Restricted. Alt 43702 (gloved hands repotting a plant into a bigger pot = 'change the way to suit it').

title: Person stirring latte art in a cup
notes: Intended callback to the opening date scene (part 1 used 7.0-11.5 and 13.4-16.1). SPEED 0.8: only 0.0-7.0 is unused, so 0.0-8.0 at 0.8 = exactly 10.0 s (use 8.3 gives a 0.4 s margin); this overlaps st01's span by 1.0-1.3 s (7.0-8.3), invisible under the centre-subtitle blur. Hands stirring a latte in a mint-green cup at a wooden cafe table; the swan latte art is still intact for the first ~2 s, then stirred. Hands only. No text. File already present from part 1. Alt 51657 (Free, not used): the date partner smiling at a candle-lit table, dark and warm, no overlap.

title: Sunrise on the ocean
notes: Golden sunrise over the sea, gentle waves and rocks, sun glare low over the horizon: hopeful light for 'the liking can become clearer'. Medium bright, warm; under the centre-subtitle blur it becomes a soft golden glow. No text. One take, 16.3 s. Already on disk from an older project (mk.py symlinked it; no download). The curtains-opening and dawn-over-city clips (22240, 22066, 22101, 27834, 21143) are all Restricted. Alt 100825 (night sky turning to dawn, 8.2 s, needs speed 0.8).

title: View of a window with a curtain
notes: Soft-focus window with a dark curtain swaying gently; through the glass, warm low sun and greenery: a calm, warm closing image (a window at golden hour) for the final question and fade-out. No text. One take, 11.0 s; 0.3-11.0 gives 10.7 s (need 10.4). Already on disk from an older project (symlink; no download). Alt 101565 (dark candle-lit table, slow, Free, 10.5 s).
